newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUTE WINS FIM 80 MLN ORDERS FROM US FIRM.
newsitem.headline: RAUTE WINS FIM 80 MLN ORDERS FROM US FIRM.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Raute Oy said in a statement on Wednesday its Raute Precision unit had won orders worth 80 million markka from U.S. Guardian Industries Corporation.
The orders were for for two glass plants' raw materials systems, one to Brazil and one to the U.S..
"The total value of the deliveries is almost 80 million markka and they will be ready in summer 1998," it said.
It said the Brazilian order was its first glass industry project in South America "and therefore a major start in an area where belief in economic growth is strengthening".
